method: Exact integer bytes; deterministic patterns, explicit assumptions, independent demand/guard runs. p95 is nearest-rank daily forecast occupancy, not statistical confidence. Partial-month B2 allowance divides by full calendar days with zero prior/future usage. No combining accounts/quotas.
